$comment: Ground truth for the eval suite: five shipments, one row each, as supplied
by Meridian. This is the expected_output shape the generated agent must
Discipline (Claude.md §9): the SHAPE of this file informs the reviewer's
questions; the VALUES are the repair loop's oracle. Deriving business rules
from these numbers and encoding them directly fits the spec to the test set
rather than to the process. Anything inferred here is a hypothesis to put to
the process owner, never an answer.
Column names are verbatim from the source table, including the one that
misnames its own unit — see notes.mismatched_asn_unit.
unit: one row per shipment, not per email and not per invoice

notes.coa_total_is_derived: coa_success + failed_coa == coa_total holds on all five rows. coa_total is the number of batches the invoices list, so completeness is derived from the invoice and nothing configures a count.
notes.invoices_per_shipment: 1, 1, 1, 2, 3 — a shipment carries up to three invoices, so one row spans several emails.
notes.mismatched_asn_unit: MNBU3974949 reports 1 invoice and 14 mismatched ASN; MNBU4371364 reports 3 invoices and 9. The column is named 'Invoices (Mismatched ASN)' but cannot be counting invoices. Unit unknown — most likely line items. A question for the process owner.
notes.asn_does_not_block: Both shipments with ASN mismatches (14 and 9) are RESOLVED. Two independent data points that ASN mismatch is non-blocking. Resolves Claude.md §8's open item.
notes.goods_hypothesis: CAAU4056270 is the only row with goods_failed > 0, and the only row with invoices_failed > 0. The SOP's line-item check reads the 'Description of Goods' section, so goods_failed is probably that check counted per line item, and an invoice fails when any of its line items does. One data point — a hypothesis, not a finding.
notes.status_hypothesis: ACTIVE on every row where invoices_failed, goods_failed or failed_coa is non-zero; RESOLVED otherwise, with ASN excluded. Fits 5 of 5. Still a hypothesis: only the process owner can say what closes a shipment, and the SOP ends at 'report the discrepancy'.
notes.identifier_kind_varies: Four rows are ISO container numbers; 176-26926281 is an air waybill. The shipment key depends on mode of transport, which the SOP never mentions.
